title: Chapter 101 Advantages Beyond Range
content:
Chapter 101 Advantages Beyond Range

The next day, the morning fog dissipated and the sun rose. The large armies in Zhong Yu's camp, also reminded by the constant sound of the bugle, slowly got up and assembled, and under the leadership of their respective officers, they continued to gather.

As early as yesterday, these soldiers learned that His Majesty the Emperor, who had just arrived yesterday, had issued an order to storm the defense line of the enemy's city today.

This will be an extremely tragic war, but in their hearts, under the loyalty and awe of His Majesty the Emperor, no matter how fearful and frightened, it is impossible to retreat.

Soon, the veterans who had been trained all the year round and experienced countless wars were all assembled in less than a stick of incense. .

"Bang bang bang!"

With the sound of a snare drum, the soldiers followed the rhythm of the snare drum and moved forward slowly and regularly. The entire army looked down from the barbarian city wall, and they moved in the same way, without the slightest confusion.

The barbarian defenders who only watched were frightened in their hearts. They, who have been fighting against the other two major forces all year round, naturally understand what this kind of very disciplined army means.

That is the ability to form a well-coordinated battle formation, very skilled and easy to kill their enemies, and now there are tens of thousands of people facing them, even if they have such strict discipline, it is impossible not to let those savages Admired and shocked.

Finally, with the rapid beating of the drums, the sound suddenly became a little louder than before. Soldiers dressed in blue and red heavy armor and armed with sharp long soldiers stepped a few steps on the spot, and they were there. It stopped at a distance of 1,000 meters from the city, and the sound of metal collision resounded, with a unique military flavor.

Afterwards, Zhong Yu's imperial equestrian slowly drove out from the main camp, and went to the center of the 150,000 army that he brought. Under the siege of the central army, the defense was tightly protected!

Standing on top of his imperial slaughter, the guards around him looked solemn for a while, and the enemy guards at the top of the city looked nervous, and looked at the somewhat broken city wall in front of them for a long time.

After the previous four or five days of fighting, this simple city wall, through its many advanced siege equipment and the repeated attacks of 100,000 troops, looks dilapidated at the moment. It seems that as long as it works harder, it will Fall down anytime!

Although it is still on the battlefield, and a more tragic war is about to start, above the city head, you can still see all kinds of busy barbarians, taking advantage of the short time before the war begins, Everywhere is repairing this embarrassingly reused city wall, trying to fix more defenses before the war begins!

It seems that even the leader of the Edel tribe on the opposite side brought his tens of thousands of troops to the battlefield. I understand that we don’t have any extraordinary power here, so we still choose to act as a shrinking turtle and would rather defend this unusable Ruined the city, but also refused to take the initiative to attack!

It seemed that he was frightened by the advanced equipment and weapons of his army and the fearlessness of death under the strict discipline of the army!

Even if their high-level combat power is much more than their own, they would not dare to make a surprise attack by elite soldiers and implement beheading tactics.

Take a good look at the focus of the battlefield in the next few days. This small city will become a boneyard for hundreds of thousands of people, a meat grinder, and countless lives will be in this small square. Inside, extinguish the last youth of their lives.

"laugh--"

With the sound of the sword in Zhong Yu's hand being cut through the scabbard, this sharp sword, which has been forged by countless skilled craftsmen under Yu Guo's command, has spent several years forging, and is unsheathed from the scabbard that hides its sharpness. .

Afterwards, Zhong Yu's right hand slowly raised the sword to the top of his head, and the guards and messengers behind him also saw the emperor's intentions with interest, and signaled the surrounding drummers to beat the war drums to start the mobilization and preparation before the war.

The war drum, which had been resting for a while, sounded again. The rhythm was different from the gentle and regular one just now. It was fast and full of passion. It made people feel a sense of heroism in their hearts, and they could give up their lives in the face of the killings on the battlefield. !

Holding the sword in the right hand and raising the top of the head, this action lasted for a while. This is to allow the soldiers around to hear the drum sound, so that they can have a preparation and buffer time. Fortunately, after the order, he can immediately obey and start without any delay!

I calculated in my heart for a while, and felt that the soldiers and officers were almost ready. The sword in his right hand slammed down to his chest, and the tip of the sword pointed directly at the barbarians above the city wall. Yu's whole body spreads out!

This is a combat technique developed by him using his unique fourth-order imperial artistic conception. Using his identity as an emperor and the artistic conception he has cultivated, he slowly affects the soldiers and subordinates around him who belong to him, and subtly gives birth to an impulse and idea in their hearts to die for themselves and give everything!

Moreover, because those who are affected are originally their subordinates and are loyal to themselves, they have a little basic awareness in their hearts, so they don't have to pay too much energy!

All I need to do is to arouse that little loyalty in their hearts, expand it and spread it out over a period of time, and for such a period of time, it can just last until they start fighting on the battlefield and retreat after heavy casualties. It is extremely practical!

The first round of the first attack has begun. Zhong Yu still cherishes the lives of his soldiers. After all, those are living luck points. Even if he can recover some of them, suddenly his total property has been lost by more than half. Can't stand it!

Therefore, Zhong Yu directly took advantage of his weapons to suppress the defensive position of the city wall directly before the war, and first severely dampened their spirit and killed some of them, to open up the situation for his soldiers to siege the city next.

It's the old-fashioned crossbow array again. For something like the crossbow, Zhong Yu used the luck points and the system to exchange for a very advanced repeating crossbow in the Three Kingdoms World. This kind of crossbow can be filled with twenty fifteen centimeters. Long and short arrows.

At the same time, the rate of fire can reach one shot in three seconds, which means that these twenty arrows can be poured out in just one minute, and the maximum lethality can be achieved in the shortest time. It can be described as a cold weapon The pinnacle of the era!

Even some modern weapons are not comparable to such practical bows and crossbows, and the materials for making these crossbows are all very special items. Raw materials can only be exchanged for the system with luck points.

The bow and crossbow made of this special material completely eliminates the shortcomings of those ordinary crossbows. The range is up to 1,000 meters, and it also improves the shortcomings and weaknesses of the bow and crossbow, which are afraid of water and moisture. Now no matter it is raining. , even directly soaked in water, without the slightest problem.

However, the excellent effect and quality are also very expensive. All material costs do not include the manual processing costs in the later stage, which is full of luck.

This is the exchange price of a first-order talent. A first-order talent can fight ten people without defeat by relying on his own strength, so he is replaced by himself with a small hand crossbow.

It can be said to be extremely extravagant, but in terms of the strategic and tactical effects brought by the hand crossbow, and the long-range strike effect on the enemy, it is all worth it!
